Stop guessing offsets: before 20 m, turn your head to look at the rails, mirrors and camera, and steer by the gap to the left rail. Reverse slowly, about 1 m/s, and start the left bend earlier, with the trailer kept toward the right.

note.text: Leg 4 DNF again: 9 touches, 7 on the trailer rear-left corner at the left bend near 25 m of reversing. Straight reversing at about 1.3 m/s is easy and holds the trailer straight. Fixed hitch biases, left or right, all hit the same corner, and each retry's pull-forward cost time and risked the nose. Do not retry the same spot blindly. Instead, before the bend, stop worrying about the trailer angle and look at the left mirror and rails. Begin the left bend much earlier, with a gentle sustained curve, and keep the rear well clear of the left rail.
